name: ibm_cal_boosting_graph_seed1337
description: Time-forward holdout with features restricted to the training window: can behaviour up to a boundary predict laundering involvement after it?. Calendar-forward regime: every entity with history is scored at fixed origins (train 2022-09-05, validation 2022-09-07, test 2022-09-09) from transactions before the origin; label = involvement in a flagged transaction in [origin, origin + 2 days).

dataset.name: ibm_aml_hi_small
dataset.label_definition: positive = the (bank, account) entity is payer or payee of at least one transaction flagged Is Laundering inside the 2-day window after the origin (calendar_forward)
